title: Donkey.bas is 45 Years Old – 131 line of Glory
summary: This article celebrates the 45th anniversary of DONKEY.BAS, a legendary car racing game that shipped with IBM PC computers in the early 1980s, consisting of just 131 lines of BASIC code.
problem_solved: Preserves and celebrates early PC gaming history and the legacy of simple yet influential programming
why_valuable: Offers a glimpse into computing heritage and demonstrates how creative software emerged from extreme resource constraints
